Tests that Page.setFontFamilies and Page.setFontSizes overrides are preserved across Page.captureScreenshot with captureBeyondViewport and reset by Page.disable.
Initial: monospace resolves to Ahem: false, fixed font size: 13px
After overrides: monospace resolves to Ahem: true, fixed font size: 30px
Screenshot captured: true
After Page.captureScreenshot: monospace resolves to Ahem: true, fixed font size: 30px
After Page.disable: monospace resolves to Ahem: false, fixed font size: 13px
